subject: SIG + CAIQ deep-dive — runbook, scheduling, and post-call notes
messages:
From: Tara Singh <tara@cycloneai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: CycloneAI Security Team <security@cycloneai.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SIG/CAIQ deep-dive — sync & materials request

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this on. We're preparing a SIG/CAIQ review as part of our procurement gates and would like a focused technical deep-dive to validate data flows, logging, and key controls. Goal: close the open SIG items and confirm the CAIQ mapping.

Top asks for the call:
- A high-level runbook of what Redwood will provide (owners, artifacts, expected timelines)
- A sample of the logs/access artifacts you can share (or instructions for redaction)
- Walkthrough of your CAIQ mapping and any gaps we should expect

Can you do a 60-minute technical call next week? We have these windows: Tue 16 Feb 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 17 Feb 13:00–14:00 PT. If neither works, propose alternatives.

I attached a current SIG draft and the list of questions our InfoSec team will prioritize.

Thanks,
Tara
Tara Singh
Head of Security — CycloneAI

Attachments: cyclone_sig_draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@cycloneai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ deep-dive — sync & materials request

Hi Tara — thanks for the note and the draft. We can cover the runbook and CAIQ mapping in a 60-minute session. Tue 16 Feb 10:00–11:00 PT works for us.

Pre-call commitments from our side:
- Marcus Lin (Security, cc'd) will lead the controls walkthrough and CAIQ mapping explanation.
- Evelyn Hart (Prod & Compliance) will cover data residency and retention policies.
- Ben Carter (Customer Engineering) will demo log exports and redact patterns.

I've attached a short preflight checklist that outlines the artifacts we'll bring and the owners for each question. Please let us know which SIG items you most want to prioritize so we can timebox appropriately.

Agenda proposal (60m):
1) 10m — Introductions & scope
2) 20m — Controls & CAIQ mapping (Marcus)
3) 15m — Logs/export demo + redaction approach (Ben)
4) 10m — Open SIG Qs & next steps
5) 5m — Action items and owners

We can share a follow-up workbook (spreadsheet) with the mapping and evidence ownership.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_preflight_checklist.pdf (PDF, 400 KB)

From: Tara Singh <tara@cycloneai.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: CycloneAI Security Team <security@cycloneai.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ deep-dive — sync & materials request

Jordan — thanks, that agenda looks good. We accept Tue 16 Feb 10:00 PT.

For prioritization: please plan to cover the following SIG items first (these are the ones blocking our procurement):
- Data egress controls and encryption in-transit/at-rest
- Log retention and access logs (who, how, retention windows)
- Key management (KMS/HSM integrations and separation)

We will also ask about your private deployment model since we may need a VPC-only deployment for sensitive workloads.

One request: if you can pre-populate the CAIQ mapping with any known gaps (column for "expected evidence"), that speeds up downstream review.

See you Tue.

Tara

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Tara Singh <tara@cycloneai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Post-call notes: SIG/CAIQ run-through (16 Feb)

Thanks again for the call earlier — notes and immediate actions below. Meeting ran 60 minutes; participants included Marcus, Ben, Evelyn, Tara, and two CycloneAI engineers (Anil and Priya).

Key takeaways:
- Encryption: we confirmed TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest, and customer-managed KMS options for Private deployments. Marcus to share KMS architecture diagram.
- Logs: Redaction approach demonstrated (Ben). We can provide sanitized access logs and a 90-day retention window for hosted accounts; Dedicated can be configured for longer retention per contract.
- CAIQ mapping: we walked through 70% of controls. Highlighted gaps: FIM evidence (file integrity monitoring), org-level background check attestation. We marked owner columns in the workbook.

Action items (owners, due dates):
- Marcus Lin: KMS/HSM architecture diagram + list of key rotation cadence (due 2027-02-19) — attachment: redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx (will populate evidence columns).
- Ben Carter: example sanitized access log sample + redaction recipe (due 2027-02-19) — attachment to follow.
- Evelyn Hart: Private deployment checklist and expected SLAs for retention (due 2027-02-21).
- Jordan Blake: Consolidate workbook and send DocuSign link for any contractual addenda requested by CycloneAI (due 2027-02-20).

Open questions for CycloneAI:
- Can you confirm whether you require SOC 2 Type II reports for procurement or whether the SIG/CAIQ mapping is sufficient for this phase?
- For private deployment, please share network egress constraints (subnet ranges) prior to the dry run.

I'll upload the workbook with owners once Marcus has added the KMS details. Thanks all.

— Jordan

Quoted in-line from call: "We want clear evidence owners so we can unblock procurement by next week."

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Internal follow-up: evidence owners + delivery windows (CycloneAI)

Folks — small internal follow-up after the CycloneAI call. Copying the action items from the notes and adding clarifying guidance. Please reply with any blocking issues.

1) Marcus — KMS diagram & key rotation cadence. Use the KMS export template in the shared Drive (link above). Target: 2027-02-19 EOD. If HSM specifics need legal approval, flag immediately.

2) Ben — produce a 2-page sanitized log sample and a step-by-step redaction recipe. Also include a small script (psuedocode acceptable) for removing PII. Target: 2027-02-19 noon.

3) Evelyn — Private deployment checklist and a short summary of SLA options (retention & encryption defaults). Target: 2027-02-21.

4) Jordan — I'll consolidate workbook and push to CycloneAI and prepare a short cover email + DocuSign link if they request addenda. Target: 2027-02-20.

If anyone expects delays, call me; the procurement team at CycloneAI is aiming to close this sprint.

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: redwood_caiq_mapping.xlsx
